name: github-actions-gate
description: GitHub Actions Gate — verifies that a delivery (task + commit + CI run + test report) satisfies every release gate rule.

scripts.example:offline: node bin/gate.mjs evaluate --input fixtures/pass.json --json; echo '--- PASS exit $? ---'; node bin/gate.mjs evaluate --input fixtures/fail.json --json; echo '--- FAIL exit $? ---'
scripts.test:collect: node --input-type=module -e "if(!process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN){console.log('GITHUB_TOKEN not set — skipping collect smoke test');process.exit(0)} console.log('GITHUB_TOKEN present — collect smoke test would run here');"
